records.title: Convergent Evolution: How Different Language Models Learn Similar Number Representations
records.reason: The primary study analyzes numerical representations acquired during language-model training; it does not propose runtime or serving optimizations.

records.title: SpeechParaling-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Paralinguistic-Aware Speech Generation
records.reason: SpeechParaling-Bench evaluates paralinguistic speech generation and judge reliability. It introduces no LLM inference efficiency method.

records.title: Volume Transformer: Revisiting Vanilla Transformers for 3D Scene Understanding
records.reason: Volume Transformer is a 3D scene model that uses full global self-attention and training/data techniques. Its discussion of optimized software/hardware stacks is a motivation, not an LLM inference method or measured serving improvement; keep borderline because it is linked to exact attention-kernel work.

records.title: Towards Robust Endogenous Reasoning: Unifying Drift Adaptation in Non-Stationary Tuning
records.reason: CPO++ addresses reasoning drift through multimodal preference optimization during reinforcement fine-tuning; it reports robustness/capability, not inference-memory or latency improvements.

records.title: Evo-MedAgent: Beyond One-Shot Diagnosis with Agents That Remember, Reflect, and Improve
records.reason: The primary abstract describes an agent memory method that improves medical-agent accuracy but incurs one extra retrieval pass and one reflection call per case. The arXiv HTML full text could not be retrieved, so the cost/quality tradeoff and any further efficiency claims remain unresolved; linked persistent-memory lineage makes this borderline.
